Secrets of Fisk’s Fleet

Public profile: Fisk’s Fleet

The Commission

The fleet’s final commission came through the Chain Council: theft of the Pearl of Souls from Umberlee’s shrine. The Council believed it was protecting Midchain waters from Umberlee’s wrath. In truth, the Principal used the Council as a local authorizing mask — the Tessarine Concordat wanted the Pearl kept away from Aldric Drave, who they believe could use it to expand his Hierarch abilities beyond his own bloodline.

The operation: Two scout teams surveying the perimeter, one entry team inside the cave, one distraction team at the main entrance. The Pearl was secured. The fleet departed.

Umberlee’s response: Fog so thick the water was invisible, surrounding all five ships simultaneously. A rogue trench opened — all five ships plunged 80 feet down. The walls closed. Crissdalynn dove from the Red Lady’s crow’s nest, grabbed Fisk, and flew straight back up — she had only risen 50 feet when the water closed; momentum and buoyancy carried them both to the surface.

Soul Mechanics

All five ships sank simultaneously. The Pearl of Souls — still aboard the Red Lady — activated at the moment of sinking and collected the souls of all five ships’ crews. The five captains’ souls were pressed into Fisk separately, by Umberlee’s direct action, as punishment and leverage.

  • Fisk carries the five captains inside him.
  • The Pearl holds the crews.
  • Both the Pearl and the Red Lady are at the Shelfworks’ eastern edge, where the shelf descends toward the trench floor.

Rael was the only captain who entered the cave with Fisk; the other four commanded from outside. This makes Rael’s voice the loudest and most trusted of the five.

Delmar’s return trigger: A brass flagon — the sight or touch of one while any captain is surfaced brings Delmar back. Tied to the night after the mutiny when those five crewmates stayed: stranded, no ship, nothing left, one flagon passed around. The moment before the fleet existed. It anchors him to himself before any of this happened.

Serafina — DM Notes

Serafina was not aboard the Red Lady when the fleet went down. She doesn’t know Fisk is shipless and carrying five dead souls.

The marriage arrangement is open — physical encounters acceptable; the one line is denying each other’s existence to get what you want. Fisk has never tested it. He knows she would know.
